scripts.build: wxt build && wxt build -b firefox && node scripts/check-manifest.mjs
scripts.zip:chrome: EXTENSION_STORE_ZIP=1 wxt zip && EXTENSION_STORE_ZIP=1 node scripts/check-manifest.mjs
scripts.zip:firefox: EXTENSION_STORE_ZIP=1 wxt zip -b firefox && EXTENSION_STORE_ZIP=1 node scripts/check-manifest.mjs
scripts.safari:build: npm run build:chrome && xcodebuild -project "safari/Save to dosya/Save to dosya.xcodeproj" -scheme "Save to dosya" -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath safari/build build
scripts.safari:archive: npm run build:chrome && xcodebuild -project "safari/Save to dosya/Save to dosya.xcodeproj" -scheme "Save to dosya" -configuration Release -derivedDataPath safari/build archive -archivePath safari/build/SaveToDosya.xcarchive
